system.description:
During this Main Process, if you make a [Magic Attack] with the [Spirit] tag that hits the target but fails to deal even 1 point of HP Damage, you may change that attack to having any one of the following tags: [Flame] [Cold] [Shock] [Holy] or [Blight].

A special skill that transforms magical power into various properties, changing the attributes and characteristics of familiar magic. The magical power you freely manipulate appears to emit seven colors of brilliance.
